descriptionEn:
Question on § “Simple and complex substances” (Kimyo, grade 7).

Wording: Check the correct answer related to “neutron”?

Correct answer: Electrically neutral particle of the nucleus of an atom.

Neutron n⁰ has no electrical charge.

Paragraph material (support for answer):

1. Simple substances are substances consisting of atoms of the same element.

2. Complex substances are substances consisting of atoms of various elements.

3. Allotropy is the phenomenon of the formation of several simple substances from one chemical element.

4. Simple and complex substances Concepts studied • Simple substances • Complex substances An element consists of identical atoms.

Remember: the answer must match the wording of the textbook. After choosing an option, check yourself again using the text §.
descriptionUz:
§ “Oddiy va murakkab moddalar” bo‘yicha savol (Kimyo, 7-sinf).

So'z: "Neytron" bilan bog'liq to'g'ri javobni tekshiring?

To'g'ri javob: Atom yadrosining elektr neytral zarrasi.

Neytron n⁰ elektr zaryadiga ega emas.

Paragraf materiali (javobni qo'llab-quvvatlash):

1. Oddiy moddalar - bir xil element atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar.

2. Murakkab moddalar - turli elementlarning atomlaridan tashkil topgan moddalar.

3. Allotropiya - bir kimyoviy elementdan bir nechta oddiy moddalar hosil bo'lish hodisasi.

4. Oddiy va murakkab moddalar O'rganiladigan tushunchalar • Oddiy moddalar • Murakkab moddalar Element bir xil atomlardan iborat.

Esingizda bo'lsin: javob darslik matniga mos kelishi kerak. Variantni tanlagandan so'ng, § matni yordamida o'zingizni yana tekshiring.
